svg.title: The Same Link, Twelve Times — twelve of thirteen links in one rapp/1 chain are the same value
svg.desc: Two renderings of one real rapp/1 frame chain: the first fourteen frames the brainstem neighbor actually recorded. In the upper band each mark is one frame, its height and radius a pure function of that frame's own frame_hash. Below each gap sits that frame's prev value, drawn as six ticks read from the prev hex, so identical prev values render as identical stamps. Twelve of the thirteen links are the same stamp, because rapp/1 section 7.4 binds prev to the predecessor's payload_hash and every heartbeat payload in this chain is byte-identical. The lower half removes six frames from the middle, renumbers the survivors and recomputes their frame_hash. Every silhouette in the surviving run changes, and not one link stamp does, because no link ever referred to a frame. Deleting frames and leaving the numbering alone is refused, because seq stops being contiguous; deleting them and renumbering the survivors is not. Both rows here pass the reference verifier frame by frame. What refuses the forgery is section 7.6: a head of record, the highest seq and frame_hash some consumer wrote down somewhere else. Until this file was published, nobody had written this chain's down. The full fourteen frames are embedded in this file's metadata element so a stranger can rerun the whole demonstration.
svg.text: rappid:@kody-w/watcher-brainstem — 14 frames, 13 links, 3 distinct link values
every mark is a pure function of its own frame_hash · all 14 distinct
each stamp is that frame's prev, read from the hex — one from the genesis payload, 12 identical
II. six frames removed from the middle
survivors renumbered 0–7, every surviving frame_hash recomputed, not one prev edited — and it verifies, frame by frame
§7.5 step 4 asks prev == head.payload_hash. Twelve heartbeats share one payload, so twelve of these thirteen links are one repeated value.
A cut alone is refused — seq goes non-contiguous. A cut that renumbers the survivors and reseals frame_hash is not: 8 of 8 PASS, 0 prev edited.
What refuses it is §7.6: a head (seq, frame_hash) some consumer wrote down elsewhere. Nobody had written this stream's down. This file does. CC0-1.0.
